name: Jackie Blue
roles: Equal Employment Opportunities Commissioner, Human Rights Commission (2013–2018)
photo_credit: New Zealand Government, Office of the Governor-General — https://gg.govt.nz/image-galleries/8408/media?page=4
status_detail: Former National list MP (2005–2013) and EEO Commissioner (2013–2018). Quit National in March 2026 over pay-equity changes and joined The Opportunity Party to mentor its leader Qiulae Wong.
